title: A08 Residual Dependence and Scientific Evidence Sufficiency Specification

positive_marginal_lcbs.formula: hat_p_i^- > 0 for all i in I
positive_marginal_lcbs.description: If any single-agent failure lower confidence bound hat_p_i^- equals 0, the ratio estimator denominator is 0 and hat_rho_UCB fails closed to infinity (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE).

statistical_precision_requirement.description: The estimated dependence ratio hat_rho_UCB must achieve adequate statistical precision relative to hat_rho. Excessively wide intervals due to sample sparsity fail closed to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

implementation_evidence_floors.description: Operational guardrails ensuring non-degenerate contingency tables before subset evaluation.

unestimable_rho_fallback.description: When rho is not estimable, exact configured-k joint failure UCB is reported with zero cross-k extrapolation credited.
